title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF LEYTE TO RENT AND MAINTAIN A JAIL AT MAASIN, IN THAT PROVINCE.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF LEYTE TO RENT AND MAINTAIN A JAIL AT MAASIN, IN THAT PROVINCE.

text.en:
The provincial board of the Province of Leyte is hereby authorized to rent a jail and maintain the
same at Maasin, that province, and to appoint a jailor and other necessary employees to care for the prisoners
in such jail. The expense of establishing and keeping said jail and of maintaining the prisoners therein shall
be home by the province.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 28, 1902.
